celebrateText: Great work — your streak goes on.
waitingText: {count, plural, one {# word is settling in} other {# words are settling in}}: new words come back in a few minutes so they stick.
tipText: Great run! Right now you only answer “Forgot” or “Remembered”. Turn on four grades and the review schedule will fit your memory more closely. The new grades are swipes up and down.
tipHard: “Hard” (swipe down) — remembered, but with effort: the word comes back a little sooner and counts as harder.
tipEasy: “Easy” (swipe up) — remembered instantly: the next review comes later and the word counts as easier, so its intervals grow faster.
introText: Look at the card and try to recall the word.
introRemembered: {direction, select, right {Swipe right} other {Swipe left}} — “Remembered”: the word comes back later.
introForgot: {direction, select, right {Swipe right} other {Swipe left}} — “Forgot”: the word comes back again soon.
introFlip: Not sure? Tap the card to turn it over and check the answer, then swipe.
libraryTitle: New words are in the library
libraryText: Ready-made decks by topic and level: quickly pick words and add them to your study right away.

quiz.listenPick: Listen to the word and pick its translation

quizIntro.title: How the test works
quizIntro.text: Pick the right answer out of four. Every word goes through three levels, from the easiest to the hardest:

levels.translation: You see the word — pick its translation.
levels.word: You see the translation — pick the word.
levels.audio: You hear the word — pick its translation. The word can be shown.

quizIntro.progress: A right answer moves the word a level up, a mistake moves it down.

prompt.SENT_PICK: Pick the word missing from the sentence

sentence.noSpeech: Nothing heard. Try again closer to the microphone.
sentence.failed: Could not recognize it. Try again.
sentence.noMic: This browser cannot listen — type the word.
sentence.micDenied: The microphone is not allowed — type the word.

sentenceIntro.title: How the sentences work
sentenceIntro.text: A word is missing from the sentence, and its translation is below. Every word goes through three levels:

levels.pick: Pick the missing word out of four.
levels.say: Say the word aloud, and it goes into its place. Without a microphone you can type it.

sentenceIntro.progress: A right answer moves the word a level up. After a mistake the level stays, but the sentence changes.

lab.title: Study modes lab
lab.intro: Any mode and level on your words. Nothing is saved here, and the words come round endlessly.
lab.locked: The lab is part of developer mode. Turn it on in the settings with the developer code.
